title: Unify Media Lattice With Resource Registry
description:
Unify the dead-code MediaType lattice (MediaClass/MediaForm/MediaType/MediaWireFormat/MediaKindDescriptor/MediaPortDirection/MediaPortSpec/media_types_compatible) in framework/core/rs/lib.rs (~lines 979-1105) with the concurrently-landed manifest-fed resource-kind registry in framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs (RESOURCE_KIND_REGISTRY, register_resource_descriptors, OsResourceDescriptor, resource_kinds), which currently uses plain string resource_kind ids and does not reference MediaType at all.

Steps:
1. Read framework/core/rs/lib.rs for the MediaType lattice, AppDefinition, and whatever descriptor/spec type currently backs .resource_kind() on AppBuilder.
2. Read framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs's resource registry region to understand descriptor flow from plugin manifest -> registry.
3. Read framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs's AppBuilder .resource_kind(...) method signature.
4. Extend the canonical descriptor/spec struct backing resource_kind with a media_type: MediaType field (+ schema/export_formats/import_formats if not already present, reusing MediaKindDescriptor field names if applicable) so registry lookups (list_os_resource_descriptors/os_resource_descriptor) return a populated media_type.
5. Drop AppDefinition.media_kinds if redundant and unconsumed elsewhere (verify first; keep + explain if something reads it).
6. Add AppBuilder.media_input(MediaPortSpec) / .media_output(MediaPortSpec) builder methods threading into AppDefinition.media_inputs/media_outputs: Vec<MediaPortSpec>, with validation (unique port ids, MediaForm::Any only legal on inputs) mirroring existing builder validation style.
7. Regenerate ts-rs TypeScript bindings via the repo's typegen command.
8. Do NOT touch s/plugin/rs/lib.rs or connect-handler validation logic (dependent ticket). Do NOT touch the ~25 plugin crates' .resource_kind() call sites unless a field rename mechanically forces it (then fix all of them minimally).

Verify with cargo check -p semio-framework-core -p semio-framework-plugin -p semio-framework-os (confirm exact package names), and cargo check --workspace if any plugin crate call sites broke.
summary: Implemented ENERGY norm family completeness gaps across DIN 4108, DIN EN 16798, and DIN V 18599: full envelope/environment checks, ISO 7730 PMV/PPD, balance_annual all 12 parts, expanded Document structs, clause-cited primary energy factors, distinct tabular method for part 12. All 41 unit tests pass.
